dedupe_keys.name: trai independent drive test reports and myspeed crowdsourced speed tests measured mobile network quality in india

description: TRAI measures mobile network quality in India in two ways. Independent Drive Tests (IDT), carried out by an appointed agency under the supervision of TRAI regional offices, establish live voice and data sessions with SIM cards of all operators over 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G on test handsets along city drives, highways, hotspots, transport hubs and walk tests. The reports give coverage, call drop rate, call setup success rate, download and upload throughput and other quality parameters per operator, with route maps; for example, the Chennai test of 15 to 17 July 2026 covered a 232.8 km city drive, 7 hotspots and a 9.9 km walk, and was released on 17 September 2026 as a press release and a report of about 10 MB. Reports are listed by licensed service area, with several each month. The MySpeed app and website let users test their mobile and broadband speeds, and TRAI publishes aggregated MySpeed results through its analytics portal. Coverage: India, by service area, city and highway route. Format and access: PDF reports and press releases, free; the MySpeed portal is a web application. Caveats: drive test results describe the route and time tested only; the analytics portal and the national data portal did not answer automated requests, so MySpeed data downloads were not checked. Simulation uses: measured coverage and throughput by operator along roads and in cities, for validating coverage models and setting service levels after disruption. Related records: the TRAI performance indicators give provider-reported quality, and Breitbandmessung and NetTest are comparable measurement tools elsewhere.
